## Change

What changed? (Describe the change technically)

## Reason

Why is this necessary? (Link to issue or provide context)

## Classification

[ ] LEVEL-0 — Documentation only
[ ] LEVEL-1 — Low-risk implementation change
[ ] LEVEL-2 — Behavioral change
[ ] LEVEL-3 — Architectural change
[ ] LEVEL-4 — Security / State / Pipeline change

## Evidence

What proves the change is correct? (Logs, screenshots, terminal output)

## Tests

What tests cover it? (Unit, Integration, E2E)

## Architecture Impact

Does this change:
- pipeline?
- state?
- gates?
- engine?
- API?
- Agent behavior?
- MCP boundaries?

*If yes to any, ensure an ADR and architectural review are completed.*

## Documentation Impact

What documentation changed? (List updated files)

## Rollback

How can this change be safely reverted? (Provide step-by-step instructions or state if git revert is sufficient)

## Known Risks

None / documented below
